label: v157
changes: Appointments for your children now show up under your children. Anything imported from Google Calendar arrived tagged to nobody — Google doesn't know who lives in your house — so "Ganga – Orthodontist" sat on the calendar and appeared on nobody's Check-ups or Medical screen. The app now reads the name in the title and files it under that person.
It works on everything already in your calendar, not just new imports, so the appointments that were missing are there now without you doing anything.
Where a person was worked out from the title rather than tagged by hand, it says so. If it ever guesses wrong, open the event and assign it properly — your choice always wins from then on.
